mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.users (id, email, password_hash, first_name, last_name, status, email_verified, locale, onboarding_completed, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{emailVerified}, #{locale}, #{onboardingCompleted}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, password_hash, first_name, last_name, status, email_verified, locale, avatar_url, last_global_signout_at, first_sign_in_at, onboarding_completed, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM public.users WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, email, password_hash, first_name, last_name, status, email_verified, locale, avatar_url, last_global_signout_at, first_sign_in_at, onboarding_completed, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM public.users WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT id, email, password_hash, first_name, last_name, status, email_verified, locale, avatar_url, last_global_signout_at, first_sign_in_at, onboarding_completed, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM public.users ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT u.id, u.email, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.status, u.email_verified, u.locale, u.avatar_url, u.first_sign_in_at, u.onboarding_completed, u.created_at, u.updated_at, array_agg(DISTINCT t.name ORDER BY t.name) FILTER (WHERE t.name IS NOT NULL) AS organizations, array_agg(DISTINCT a.authority ORDER BY a.authority) FILTER (WHERE a.authority IS NOT NULL) AS membership_authorities FROM public.users u LEFT JOIN public.tenant_memberships m ON m.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN public.tenants t ON t.tenant_key = m.tenant_key LEFT JOIN public.tenant_member_authorities a ON a.membership_id = m.id WHERE u.id = #{id} GROUP BY u.id, u.email, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.status, u.email_verified, u.locale, u.avatar_url, u.first_sign_in_at, u.onboarding_completed, u.created_at, u.updated_at

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users WHERE email = #{email})

SELECT u.id, u.email, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.status, u.email_verified, u.locale, u.avatar_url, u.first_sign_in_at, u.onboarding_completed, u.created_at, u.updated_at, array_agg(DISTINCT t.name ORDER BY t.name) FILTER (WHERE t.name IS NOT NULL) AS organizations, array_agg(DISTINCT a.authority ORDER BY a.authority) FILTER (WHERE a.authority IS NOT NULL) AS membership_authorities FROM public.users u LEFT JOIN public.tenant_memberships m ON m.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN public.tenants t ON t.tenant_key = m.tenant_key LEFT JOIN public.tenant_member_authorities a ON a.membership_id = m.id
( LOWER(u.email) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')) OR LOWER(u.first_name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')) OR LOWER(u.last_name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')) )
AND u.status = #{status}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.platform_authorities pa WHERE pa.user_id = u.id AND pa.authority = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' )
GROUP BY u.id, u.email, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.status, u.email_verified, u.locale, u.avatar_url, u.first_sign_in_at, u.onboarding_completed, u.created_at, u.updated_at ORDER BY
u.email u.first_name u.last_name u.updated_at u.created_at
ASC DESC
, u.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT
TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', m.created_at), 'YYYY-MM')
TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('day', m.created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AS period, COUNT(*) AS signups FROM public.tenant_memberships m WHERE m.tenant_key = #{tenantKey} AND m.created_at >= #{from}::date AND m.created_at < #{to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY period ORDER BY period ASC
